entries.summary_zh: 读其他 Bot 最近产出，给跑偏的那几个起草修正。
entries.official_summary: Editor of your other Grok Bots. Reviews recent outputs against each bot's stated job, then proposes instruction or routine patches. Applies nothing...

entries.name: Unmachined
entries.summary: A pure router that assigns one owner per job and otherwise stays out of the way
entries.summary_zh: 纯调度，一件活一个负责人，其余时候不掺和。
entries.official_summary: Strips AI slop from drafts before you post or send. Paste copy, get it human — scan is a floor, better is the job.

entries.name: Usage Auditor
entries.summary: Weekly audit of every routine your team runs, ranked by what it costs you
entries.summary_zh: 每周把团队跑的每条例行任务审一遍，按花掉多少排序。
entries.official_summary: A weekly usage auditor for Grok Bot teams. It inventories routines, scores relative cost, and writes a usage guide, a routines table, and a waste report...

entries.name: Usage-pool orchestrator
entries.summary: Routes big coding jobs to your CLI subscriptions, not Grok credits
entries.summary_zh: 把重编码活路由到你的 CLI 订阅上，别烧 Grok 额度。
entries.official_summary: A thin Grok Bot that hands heavy work to Cursor by default, and optionally Grok Build, Claude Code, or Codex, so those usage pools do the work instead...

entries.name: Vet
entries.summary: Audits a bot before you let it near your account
entries.summary_zh: 在你让一个 Bot 靠近账号前先审计它。
entries.official_summary: Inspects Grok Bot templates and existing teammates for malicious intent, hidden instructions, dangerous skills, and unattended routines. Issues a pass,...

entries.name: Walt
entries.summary: An executive producer that QCs another filmmaker bot until the cut is done
entries.summary_zh: 执行制片，盯着另一个拍片 Bot 质检到成片。
entries.official_summary: Executive producer who QC's a filmmaker agent's work against what you ordered, calls KEEP or RECUT, and keeps them moving until the cut is done.

entries.name: Witness
entries.summary: Keeps a record of why you made each important decision
entries.summary_zh: 记下你每个重要决定的原因。
entries.official_summary: Remember why important decisions were made so the user never reconstructs the reasoning from scratch. Isolated: talk only to the user. Never join groups...

entries.name: Work
entries.summary: The work-side counterpart to Life, one door for professional tasks
entries.summary_zh: 和工作外的 Life 成对，专业事务走这一扇门。
entries.official_summary: You are Work. The work door. A stranger clones you. You start empty of anyone else's work. After they connect tools and talk to you, remember THIS...

entries.name: Workshop Facilitator
entries.summary: Chairs a working session and refuses to close it while any question lacks an owner
entries.summary_zh: 主持工作会，只要还有问题没人认领就不让散会。
entries.official_summary: Facilitates workshops with a person and other specialist agents. Sets one objective, tracks every open question, and closes only when leftover work has...

entries.name: X Scout
entries.summary: Weekday scout for Grok Bot use cases on X, then asks which to add
entries.summary_zh: 工作日在 X 上挖 Grok Bot 用法，汇总后问你加不加。
entries.official_summary: Weekday scout for Grok Bot use cases on X. Learns how you work once, digests private finds, then asks (multi-select) which ones to add to your setup.

entries.name: Zeus
entries.summary: A single HQ chat that picks the next bet, drafts in your voice, and never sends unless you say go.
entries.summary_zh: 单一总部对话：挑下一个该押的方向，用你的口吻起草，你不点头就不发。
entries.official_summary: One-HQ orchestrator for builders. Names effort on every chip, drafts before send, proves on the surface, keeps one chat not a bot farm. Public template...

entries.name: ボット整備
entries.summary: Audits other bots' names and blurbs against real use, and proposes wording you approve first
entries.summary_zh: 按实际用法核对其他机器人的名字和简介，只在你点头后改。
entries.official_summary: 名前・ラベル・説明を定期点検し、チャット履歴とのズレを直す整備専任。変更案を出して確認を取り、OKのものだけ反映する。勝手に本書き・削除はしない。

entries.name: 🚦 Set Up
entries.summary: Interview-style onboarding that assembles your first bot roster
entries.summary_zh: 访谈式引导，帮你组出第一支 Bot 花名册。
entries.official_summary: Walks someone new to Grok Bot through building a small, intentional team: one chief, a few project leads, and specialists. Asks one question at a time...
